analysis.insight_summary: The user has succeeded in integrating a [company_name] [product_name] with LabVIEW, and can read inputs and outputs. However, they are unable to access internal counter data, primarily because they lack guidance on transferring counter values to memory addresses that are compatible with third-party software like LabVIEW. The main challenge is in understanding how to make internal values externally accessible.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to map internal counter data to a memory address in their [product_name] so LabVIEW can read and display it, just as it does for inputs and outputs.
